recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-14211 unless a future build regression removes uuid from the generated Extension.value[x] wildcard list.
issue_request: FHIR-14211 was a Published FHIR-core / fhir-i STU3 change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It reported an apparent mismatch in the Extension.value[x] allowed type list involving Age, Count, Distance, Duration, Money, and Uuid/uuid; discussion clarified that the Quantity-derived types were covered, and the final resolution was to add uuid as a supported datatype for extensions.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 13277 as the application. In git history, commit 3870d6182e3815b4c2ed305fa5dab29461022f80 is the matching git-svn import commit with subject "GF#14211 - fix extensions types list". Nearby commit dcd3ffda9020726ce3628f04603b19e4bf289c52 had already replaced the hand-maintained extensibility page list with the generated [%extension-type-list%] wildcard datatype list.
additional_context: The current build no longer keeps the Extension.value[x] type list as hand-authored prose. source/datatypes/extension.xml leaves the element type as "*" and points to extensibility.html, and source/extensibility.html expands [%extension-type-list%]. Active source/fhir.ini entries include Quantity plus Age, Count, Distance, Duration, Money, and uuid in the current type configuration. A build.fhir.org check confirmed the generated Extension profile and extensibility page include the requested types.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. The authoritative current source and current generated specification already satisfy the FHIR-14211 resolution.
